goals.title: Drain in-flight pipeline
goals.objective: Land CMR-008 autosave+CRC, CMR-009 14-SFX audio, CMR-010 3-slot save UI, CMR-015 battle juice, CMR-016 achievements; pipeline empty of in-progress/review work
goals.evidence: Landed CMR-008/009/010/015/016 in commit be2d8ed. 61/61 vitest (+19 new tests across audio + achievements + damagePopup + saveStore CRC/rollback/slot list). Lint zero warnings, typecheck strict clean, build 248 KB gzip JS (within 300 KB cap). New modules: src/game/Sim/Saves/crc32.ts, src/audio/SoundManager.ts, src/achievements/{registry,store,trigger}.ts, src/ui/AchievementToast.tsx, src/ui/battle/damagePopup.ts. Behavioral wins: corruption-safe save with __prev rollback, 60 sim-second autosave to 'autosave' slot, 14 SFX wired at trigger sites, HP-bar 300ms easeOutCubic tween + per-side damage popups + rAF crit shake (reduced-motion gated), 10 device-scoped achievements with 4s toast.

goals.title: Player agency
goals.objective: WorkPriority grid (per-warden x worktype, 0-4), 24h Schedule grid (Sleep/Work/Joy/Anything), Draft mode (click orders override autonomy), unified Priority+Schedule panel (CMR-031/032/039/040)
goals.evidence: Landed CMR-031/032/039/040 in 0b68cc2. 70/70 vitest (+9 new agency tests). Lint zero warnings, typecheck strict clean, build 250 KB gzip JS. New module src/game/Sim/agency.ts + src/ui/panels/PrioritiesPanel.tsx. SimWorld.agency side-maps hold WorkPriority + Schedule + Draft; jobs/construct/behavior systems honor them. Right-click in Game.handleTileClick routes only to drafted wardens when any exist. P-hotkey + HUD button open the panel. Known limitation: agency state is not yet in SaveDoc v3 — picked up by F007 v4 migration.

goals.title: Economic depth
goals.objective: Items on tiles + Stockpile zones + Haul job + Workstation bills (recipe queue with repeat-until-X stop rule) (CMR-034/035/036)
goals.evidence: Landed CMR-034 + CMR-035 in a00ea34. CMR-036 (workstation bills) deferred — requires cook system from CMR-041 (G006). 74/74 vitest (+4 haul tests). Lint zero warnings, typecheck strict clean, build 252 KB gzip JS. New modules src/game/Sim/Items/{defs,spawn}.ts + src/game/Sim/systems/haul.ts. Item + Carry components added; SimWorld.stockpiles Set<tileKey>; haul system runs every 6 ticks, picks nearest unreserved loose item, carries to nearest stockpile. EntityLayer renders Items as diamonds. New 'stockpile' tool (hotkey Z). Items not yet in SaveDoc — covered by F007.

goals.evidence: Landed CMR-019 + CMR-021 + CMR-027 in dd14674. 79/79 vitest (+5 trait tests). Lint zero warnings, typecheck strict clean, build 254 KB gzip JS. New module src/game/Sim/Critters/traits.ts (7 traits, rollTrait, applyTrait). Wild AI v2: home anchor + pack centroid + low-HP flee in src/game/Sim/systems/wildAi.ts.
